channel.title: Lakefront Luxury
channel.desc: Jeff and Susan are on the hunt for the perfect home to host family, entertain grandkids, and showcase Susan's impressive record collection; their tour takes them from a sleek lakeside new build with a sky deck and hot tub, to a traditional family retreat with a private movie theatre and beach, and finally to a renovated 1950s gem featuring a rustic-chic interior, a showstopping cobalt blue cooking station from France, and outdoor entertaining spaces made for unforgettable gatherings.
